name: recommended table profile
description: Recommended fields of the World Bank table schema for a table extracted from a document, with the reason each field matters. The schema itself requires only table_description.title_statement.idno and .title.

fields.table_description.title_statement.idno: The identifier of the extracted table, which includes the document identifier and the table number.
fields.table_description.title_statement.title: The title as printed, so that a search for the printed title finds the data.
fields.table_description.table_columns: Column labels with units; the meaning of the values.
fields.table_description.data_sources: The document, page, and the series or survey the table was built from; the provenance an answer cites.
fields.table_description.time_periods: The reference period of the values.
fields.metadata_information.production_date: When the extraction was made; freshness relative to the document.
fields.table_description.table_rows: Row labels, so that a value can be addressed by row and column.
fields.table_description.definitions: Definitions of the measures, linked to the indicator definitions where they exist.
fields.table_description.license: The licence of the source document applies to the extracted data; state it.
fields.table_description.citation: The citation to the document and page that users and systems should copy.
fields.table_description.relations: The link to the document record (isPartOf), so that document and data find each other.
fields.table_description.identifiers: A DOI or persistent identifier for the extracted table.
fields.table_description.links: The tidy file and the snapshot image.
